summary: iter-10 frontend-only test. Verified lat/lng forwarding from useUserLocation into /api/products, /api/shop-layout, /api/services. Baseline (no location captured) correctly omits lat/lng. Geolocation set via page.context.set_geolocation(12.97, 77.59); loc-capture clicked; loc-update appeared; reload + navigation triggered XHRs with lat=12.97&lng=77.59. /services pincode auto-fill semantics correct (backend did NOT return pincode in POST /users/me/location response, so input stayed empty as gated). All iter-9 regression items still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Shop.jsx locParams memo is well-scoped on lat/lng/pincode primitives — avoids reference churn. Good.
Services.jsx load() depends on location.lat/lng but reads q/pincode via refs — refetch on PIN change requires explicit Search click, which matches existing UX. OK.
useUserLocation.js does not verify HTTPS or handle stale cache invalidation; minor (not in scope of this iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Geolocation can be mocked via page.context().grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=...) + page.context().set_geolocation({latitude, longitude, accuracy}). Capture XHR query params via page.on('request', handler) and parse_qs(urlparse(req.url).query). Live backend at network-pay-1.emergent.host does NOT yet filter by lat/lng but FastAPI tolerates unknown params — confirmed 200 OK with lat/lng forwarded. Stored location object from backend has shape {ok:true, location:{user_location_lat,user_location_lng,user_location_updated_at}} without pincode — that's why Services pincode auto-fill stays empty (correct gated behavior).

test_outcomes.services_pincode_autofill_gated_on_exist: PASS (backend returned no pincode → input empty, as designed)
